meta.title: Botelix - Deposit Return Scheme for WooCommerce, Live Preview
meta.author: WPPoland

steps.code:
<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
delete_transient('_wc_activation_redirect');
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('skipped'=>true, 'completed'=>true));
update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country', 'PL');
update_option('woocommerce_default_customer_address', 'base');
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'PLN');
update_option('botelix_settings', array('enabled'=>'1', 'default_scheme'=>'pl', 'enable_destination_matching'=>'1', 'exempt_unsupported_exports'=>'1'));
if (function_exists('wc_get_product_id_by_sku') && class_exists('WC_Product_Simple')) {
  $demo = array(
    array('Spring Mineral Water 0.5 l', '3.49', 'pet', 1),
    array('Citrus Soda Cans, 6-pack', '17.99', 'can', 6),
    array('Amber Lager 0.5 l, Returnable Glass', '6.99', 'glass_reusable', 1),
    array('Sparkling Water Crate, 12 x 1.5 l', '29.99', 'pet', 12),
  );
  foreach ($demo as $d) {
    $sku = 'demo-'.sanitize_title($d[0]);
    if (wc_get_product_id_by_sku($sku)) { continue; }
    $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $p->set_name($d[0]); $p->set_sku($sku); $p->set_regular_price($d[1]);
    $p->set_status('publish'); $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
    $p->update_meta_data('_botelix_packaging_type', $d[2]);
    $p->update_meta_data('_botelix_packaging_units', (string) $d[3]);
    $p->save();
  }
}
